items.title: The locus where two relative cycles on the fibres agree is closed
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: 7 行陈述（68 行证明）、两相对循环在纤维上相等点的集合是闭集：四段归约（局部化、proper 覆盖入像、并集挤压、局部结构图搬运非零系数）+ 平滑性开性收尾。4 处引用全具名，无 omit，干净收。

primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-relative-cycles-equal (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 1305-1311

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: Reduce locally on S and via an affine cover, replace the difference of the two cycles and use a jointly surjective family of proper morphisms putting it into the image of the cycle-classes construction, squeeze onto the scheme-theoretic union of the supporting subschemes, then at a point outside the equal locus localize to a single component, apply the local structure lemma for finite type morphisms, transport the nonvanishing coefficient through flat pullback and pushforward, and conclude by the smoothness lemma and openness (source lines 1313-1380)
